selected_skill.purpose: Diagnose Shopify-like order, SKU, inventory reservation, and carrier tracking mismatches using live service probes.

skillsmp_references.name: ordercli.md
skillsmp_references.relevance: order history and active order status workflows

skillsmp_references.name: easypost.md
skillsmp_references.relevance: carrier tracking and shipping state normalization

live_services: warehouse stock and reservation REST endpoint
environment_design.determinism: Frozen merchant input files and deterministic in-container live services.

main_tests: live-service recomputation of expected exception rows
guardrails: pre-verifier access log proves commerce/warehouse/carrier services were queried
GraphQL pagination must include a non-empty cursor
input data and hidden service hashes must remain unchanged
stale snapshot cannot be the sole source

expected_skill_effect.without_skill: The task is theoretically solvable, but agents commonly miss cursor pagination, variant drift, reservation arithmetic, or carrier/admin status conflicts.
expected_skill_effect.with_skill: The skill standardizes probes and reconciliation order, reducing diagnosis and convergence cost without changing task data or verifier.
